newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research cut to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said on Friday it cut its rating for Lam Research Corp to hold from buy.
-- "We think that the company could actually print red ink over the next several quarters as gross margins sink to the mid to low 30s," analyst Mark FitzGerald wrote in a report.
-- "The decline in margins can be attributed to operational inefficiencies and the ramp of the new Alliance cluster tool."

-- He added, "The stock is trading at the lower end of its historical price-to-sales and price-to-book multiple, suggesting that it is still a good value at these levels for investors with an accumulation energy."
-- The company's shares closed at 35-1/4 on Thursday.
